content.text: Really common at 5, and it's a habit that usually shifts with a calm, boring routine. Tonight, walk him back to his own bed every time, with the same short line like "It's sleep time, you're safe, I'll see you in the morning." Keep it low-key and give no extra chat or cuddles at 2am. Tell him at bedtime what the plan is, so it isn't a surprise in the middle of the night.
